H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H4911: to liken, i.e. (transitively) to use figurative language (an allegory, adage, song or the like); intransitively, to resemble
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H4912: properly, a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature; hence, a simile (as an adage, poem, discourse)
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H1: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
H8127: a tooth (as sharp); specifically ivory; figuratively, a cliff
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H5750: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H2007: themselves (often used emphatic for the copula, also in indirect relation)
H2398: properly, to miss; hence (figuratively and generally) to sin; by inference, to forfeit, lack, expiate, repent, (causatively) lead astray, condemn
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H4191: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H4941: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
H6666: rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity)
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H5375: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
H1544: properly, a log (as round); by implication, an idol
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H2930: to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense (contaminated)
H5079: properly, rejection; by implication, impurity, especially personal (menstruation) or moral (idolatry, incest)
H7126: to approach (causatively, bring near) for whatever purpose
H3238: to rage or be violent; by implication, to suppress, to maltreat
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H1497: to pluck off; specifically to flay, strip or rob
H3899: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H3680: properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy)
H899: a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage
H8636: multiplication, i.e. percentage or bonus in addition to principal
H3947: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H996: between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or
H2708: {an enactment; hence, an appointment (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage)}
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H2421: to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive
H3205: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage
H8210: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out
H1818: blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood)
H251: a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like father))
H259: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H8441: properly, something disgusting (morally), i.e. (as noun) an abhorrence; especially idolatry or (concretely) an idol
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H2403: an offence (sometimes habitual sinfulness), and its penalty, occasion, sacrifice, or expiation; also (concretely) an offender
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H2254: to wind tightly (as a rope), i.e. to bind; specifically, by a pledge; figuratively, to pervert, destroy; also to writhe in pain (especially of parturition)
H6231: to press upon, i.e. oppress, defraud, violate, overflow
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H8432: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H2142: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; to be male
H2654: properly, to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively, to be pleased with, desire
H4194: death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence, ruin
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H4603: properly, to cover up; used only figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. treacherously
H8505: to balance, i.e. measure out (by weight or dimension); figuratively, arrange, equalize, through the idea of levelling (ment. estimate, test)
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H4994: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H8199: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)
H4383: a stumbling-block, literally or figuratively (obstacle, enticement (specifically an idol), scruple)
H7993: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively)
H6586: to break away (from just authority), i.e. trespass, apostatize, quarrel
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
